name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 24 times in 9 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2026-07-13, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
